review_notes: Reviewed all lines 1–134, the related coinduction and finite-support definitions, the adjunction API, and downstream uses. The proposed replacement was not compiled.

findings.excerpt:
lemma moduleCoindInclusion_mono (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) : Mono (moduleCoindInclusion k R M) := by
  apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mpr
  intro x y h
  have hh := congrArg (fun g : coind k R ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap k R)).obj M) => g (1 : R)) h
  change (1 : R) • x = (1 : R) • y at hh
  simpa using hh
findings.problem: The elementwise injectivity argument reproves the general fact that the unit of an adjunction with faithful left adjoint is monic. Restriction of scalars already has the required faithful instance.
findings.proposed_change:
Replace the proof with:
by
  exact (ModuleCat.restrictCoextendScalarsAdj (algebraMap k R)).unit_mono_of_L_faithful M
findings.benefit: The named result directly explains monicity at the same categorical level as the definition, avoiding elementwise evaluation and coercion bookkeeping. It preserves the existing assumptions and covers zero modules and subsingleton R as well.

evidence.excerpt:
/-- If the left adjoint is faithful, then each component of the unit is a monomorphism. -/
instance unit_mono_of_L_faithful [L.Faithful] (X : C) : Mono (h.unit.app X) where
  right_cancellation {Y} f g hfg :=
    L.map_injective <| (h.homEquiv Y (L.obj X)).injective <| by simpa using hfg

instance {R : Type u₁} {S : Type u₂} [Ring R] [Ring S] (f : R →+* S) :
    (restrictScalars.{v} f).Faithful where
  map_injective h := by
    ext x
    simpa only using! DFunLike.congr_fun (ModuleCat.hom_ext_iff.mp h) x
